scenes.title: Your referees need more time than you think.
scenes.say: Your referees need more time than you think. Here are five tips for reference letters.

scenes.title: Ask at least a month early
scenes.body: Lecturers get many requests near deadlines.
scenes.say: Ask at least a month before the deadline. Lecturers get many requests at once.

scenes.title: Pick people who know your work
scenes.body: A detailed letter beats a famous name.
scenes.say: Pick people who know your work well. A detailed letter beats a famous name.

scenes.title: Send a one-page brief
scenes.body: Programme, deadline, your CV and what you'd like them to mention.
scenes.say: Send them a one-page brief: the programme, the deadline, your C V, and what you'd like them to mention.

scenes.title: Check their email works
scenes.body: Portals send the request link to the address you enter.
scenes.say: Double-check their email address. Portals send the upload link to whatever you type.

scenes.title: Remind them kindly
scenes.body: A week before the deadline, check the portal shows it received.
scenes.say: A week before the deadline, check the portal, and send a kind reminder if it's still missing.
